title: krpoltext
text: English | 한국어 krpoltext는 다음 논문에서 소개된 두 개의 대규모 한국 정치 텍스트 코퍼스에 R에서 손쉽게 접근할 수 있도록 돕는 패키지입니다. Lim, T.H. (2025). South Korean Election Campaign Booklet Party Statements Corpora. Scientific Data, 12, 1030. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-05220-4 데이터는 Open Science Framework에 호스팅되어 있으며 (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/RCT9Y), 관리형 아티팩트가 필요할 경우 대화형 세션에서 처음 사용할 때 자동으로 다운로드됩니다. 비대화형 세션에서는 로컬 파일 경로나 미리 채워둔 cache를 사용해야 합니다.

title: krpoltext
code: library(krpoltext)  # 관리형 Parquet 아티팩트를 명시적으로 사용 ps <- load_party_statements(format = "parquet") cb <- load_campaign_booklet(format = "parquet")  # 메타데이터 확인 metadata("party_statements") schema("party_statements")  # 문서 필터링 docs_2020 <- get_docs("party_statements", year = 2020) conservative <- get_docs("party_statements", year = 2018:2022, conservative = 1) strict_subset <- get_docs(   "party_statements",   year = 2020,   .select = c("year", "title", "text"),   .strict = TRUE )  # 선거공보 데이터에서 선거 종류와 정당 기준으로 필터링 assembly <- get_docs("campaign_booklet", office = "national_assembly", .data = cb)

title: krpoltext
text: 관리형 아티팩트는 현재 OSF에서 CSV와 Parquet 두 형식으로 제공됩니다. load_*() helper는 관리형 Parquet 아티팩트를 사용할 수 있지만, download_data()는 여전히 CSV prefetch helper입니다. 로컬 CSV나 Parquet 파일 경로를 직접 넘길 수도 있습니다. 데이터는 tools::R_user_dir("krpoltext", "cache")에 압축 RDS 형태로 캐시되며, SHA-256 체크섬으로 검증됩니다. 이후 로딩은 대체로 약 2초 내외로 끝납니다.
code: # 관리형 Parquet를 명시적으로 사용 ps <- load_party_statements(format = "parquet") cb <- load_campaign_booklet(format = "parquet")  # 또는 CSV를 명시적으로 사용 ps <- load_party_statements(format = "csv") cb <- load_campaign_booklet(format = "csv")  # 두 데이터셋의 CSV cache를 미리 받아두기 download_data()  # 로컬 파일 경로를 직접 지정할 수도 있음 ps <- load_party_statements(path = "~/Downloads/sk_party_statements_v2022.csv") ps <- load_party_statements(path = "~/Downloads/sk_party_statements_v2022.parquet")

title: Replication-Ready Text Analysis Pipeline
code: library(krpoltext)  ps <- load_party_statements(format = "parquet") ps_sub <- get_docs("party_statements", year = 2010:2022, .data = ps)  cat("Documents:", nrow(ps_sub), "\n") cat("Years:", paste(range(ps_sub$year), collapse = "-"), "\n")

title: Replication-Ready Text Analysis Pipeline
code: library(quanteda)  corp <- as_quanteda_corpus(ps_sub, docid_field = "id") docvars(corp) |> head()

title: Replication-Ready Text Analysis Pipeline
text: filtered column already contains morphologically parsed Korean text (via khaiii). can use directly tokenize raw text column:
code: toks <- tokens(corp, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE) dfm_ps <- dfm(toks) dfm_ps

title: Replication-Ready Text Analysis Pipeline
code: topfeatures(dfm_ps, 20)  # By partisan group dfm_group <- dfm_group(dfm_ps, groups = partisan) topfeatures(dfm_group, 10, groups = TRUE)

title: Replication-Ready Text Analysis Pipeline
code: library(quanteda.textstats)  dfm_binary <- dfm_group(dfm_ps, groups = conservative) keyness <- textstat_keyness(dfm_binary, target = "1") head(keyness, 20)

title: Data Dictionary
text: Official election campaign booklets (공보물) 49,678 individual candidates across presidential, National Assembly, local elections South Korea (2000–2022). Text extracted via OCR (black--white, page--page using Google Drive API) parsed using khaiii Korean morphological analyzer.

title: Data Dictionary
text: Missing values: 2,283 candidates lack booklet; 151 missing biographical information. 23 booklets unprocessable (corrupted files). See paper Section “Methods” details. Identifiers: code uniquely identifies document. job_id edu_id vary across election years; use job_code edu_code consistent cross-year analysis. Caution Basic Assembly: Basic Assembly booklets lower average word counts, potentially due lower PDF quality genuinely shorter texts. See paper discussion. filtered: Morphologically parsed using khaiii; retains Korean content words.

title: Data Dictionary
text: Official statements party spokespersons minutes daily leadership meetings South Korea’s two major political parties (2003–2022): center-left Progressive Party (현 더불어민주당) center-right Conservative Party (현 국민의힘). Total: 83,201 statements (35,115 conservative + 48,086 progressive; see paper Table 9 yearly breakdown).

title: Data Dictionary
text: Missing values: fields may contain NA empty strings. Party name changes: parties undergone frequent name changes (see paper Table 3). partisan column uses stable ideological labels rather party names. filtered: Morphologically parsed using khaiii; retains Korean content words.

title: Data Dictionary
text: text UTF-8 encoded Korean. text contains full original text; filtered contains parsed version suitable direct text analysis. complete data provenance, OCR methodology, technical validation, use case examples, see Data Descriptor: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-05220-4 Supplementary Information (party name mappings, example analyses): available paper’s supplementary materials.
